change_reason: Replace fixed calendar horizon buckets with overlap-connected realized evaluation intervals so no two independent time clusters can share any evaluation dates.

definitions.feature_cutoff: strictly_before_decision_timestamp; daily market context uses prior completed close

clustering.author_independence: unique author count within each rule family, reported separately from effective sample size
clustering.time_cluster_definition: For a declared horizon, each mature event contributes [baseline_date, horizon_end_date]. Any directly or transitively overlapping intervals form one cluster. Distinct clusters must be pairwise non-overlapping.
clustering.horizon_end_source: exact realized horizon_end_date carried by EventScore from the source outcome; missing/invalid end dates are not counted as independent evidence
clustering.bootstrap_block: resample complete overlap-connected time clusters; all symbols/events in a cluster move together

multiple_testing.hypothesis_family: all active rule_family x all declared horizons under the frozen family definition, whether currently testable or not
multiple_testing.pvalue_method: cluster sign-flip null on overlap-connected time-cluster means

mae_noninferiority.pass_rule: observed mean direction-adjusted MAE >= unconditional benchmark mean direction-adjusted MAE

price_source_policy.conflict_policy: mark invalid/conflict and do not score

promotion_activation.reason: Dependence clustering changed in v1.3 from fixed calendar buckets to overlap-connected realized windows; controls must pass under the new frozen definition before any activation.
